run_plan.pair_order: off,on for even query positions; on,off for odd; same in both rounds
run_plan.metrics: Span Recall over complete exact gold quotes; chunk MRR/nDCG uses frozen actual chunk IDs/grades. All planned requests retained; failure/degradation gets zero strict quality. Report answerable-only secondary and no-answer separately.
run_plan.warm_interpretation: Every CE score starts a new process and loads weights. Second round is OS-cache warm, not resident CE inference.
run_plan.decision: Keep default off unless all gates pass; a pass only makes this synthetic configuration eligible for operator review. No production SLA, diagnosis accuracy or calibrated abstention claim.
run_plan.acceptance_rule: Run dev first. Freeze source/plan before acceptance. Never change acceptance queries, labels, retrieval budgets or gates after observing acceptance. Any bug retry gets a new source freeze/output; retain earlier attempts.

reranker.installation_integrity: setup SHA256 manifest and required-file sizes

adoption.interpretation: Synthetic local adoption screen; not a production SLA or diagnosis accuracy.

measurement_limits: Every CE score starts a new isolated process and loads its model; cache_warm_repeat means OS file-cache warm, never resident-model inference.
E5 passage indexing/model loading is separately measured; E5 remains loaded in the parent during query measurements.
Parent RSS is process lifetime high-water; CE RSS is child high-water. They are not a simultaneous RSS sum.
No answer threshold is configured. Returning context is not an answer, and an error is not a correct abstention.
Same collaborating agent authored both independent mechanism splits; no blinded human or real multi-user quality claim.
privacy: Only original synthetic IDs, corpus-relative paths and numeric rankings; no candidate body, credential, real run ID or project path.
